motionContract.intent: Uneven supported sobs, cheek wipe and clear downward tear renewal
motionContract.primaryMotion:
Umi is already tearful, trying unsuccessfully to contain a little sob while keeping one rounded paw naturally near his cheek and the other planted for support. A short catch of breath and a quick supported sob run through chest, shoulders, neck, face and the cheek-side elbow as ONE living emotional impulse. The cheek-side paw makes a small comfortable wiping response with the bent arm and shoulder, not a detached rubbing fist or a staged hand demonstration. After a brief breathing pause, a smaller uneven after-sob lets the feeling settle toward the original crying pose. Keep the two sobs different in weight and spacing. Main contractions and releases happen at ordinary lively speed, around0.2–0.4seconds; do not make the whole shot a slow smooth nod or identical pendulum bob.

Preserve the already-approved clear watery tear behavior: moisture gathers at the outer eye corners, a thin wet run travels DOWN the cheek, a rounded bead necks and detaches under gravity and falls below, while fresh moisture feeds from above. The shape changes and the drop continues down independently of the head's recovery; it is not a rigid blue strip, dangling slime ribbon or a fixed teardrop translated with the face. Keep the water small and readable, not a fountain, rope or expanding blob. The cheek-side paw stays outside the eyeball and does not drag the face or carry the whole tear as a solid prop. No new puddle, particles, sweat or extra symbols.

The original dark closed-eye lines and compact gray bean brows remain distinct throughout the sob. The small open crying mouth, tiny original upper fangs, lip corners and muzzle respond within the same breath without stretching the face wide or inventing a row of teeth. Preserve both complete compact gray paws, four-digit anatomy through natural overlap, short ivory nail tips, thick white forearms and the original pointed gray/white fur borders. The grounded resting paw maintains its support; no new fingers, pink pads on the visible backs or human palms. Folded hood ear and scarf have short weighted follow-through from the same body impulse, and the one continuous cape stays draped. End with an emotionally compatible original pose, compatible body velocity and ongoing downward tear flow for the forward loop; no freeze, ping-pong, water moving upward or snap to the supplied end image.
motionContract.supportChain: Sob carried through chest/shoulders, neck/head yielding into compact cheek-wiping paw, supported bent elbow/thick wrist and low opposite paw. Body/face/wipe overlap continuously.
motionContract.gazeHead: Closed-eye lines and bean brows remain separate as muzzle/chest respond to each sob
motionContract.secondaryMotion: Initial long tear slides and releases promptly; cheek becomes visibly clear. New small pale-blue water beads form/slide/release with clear cheek intervals. No fixed hanging column, black fleck or stain; scarf follows integrated sob.

motionContract.timingLayers: Brief ordinary-speed0.2–0.4s attention/weight changes, living pauses and smaller after-settle; no whole-shot slow sway or segmented body-part exercises.
motionContract.loopBoundary: Same original supplied pose, grounded weight and compatible motion phase; continuous forward unresolved emotion. Cry water continues downward, never reverse or endpoint paste.
motionContract.reviewOrder: A source materials/patterns against clean2D reference and original color card; B action semantics, four-digit support and natural whole-body unity; then complete native source and frozen purple matte/edge review, interior color/tear detail validation and original-speed user review.
